title: file splitname

messages.description: the separated directory and file components
file component if no directory component is found

body: [file splitname] separates the directory from the file name of a path, and outputs both as a list on the left outlet. If there is no directory component, the path goes to the right outlet. A trailing slash is removed, and the file name is the non-empty string after the last path separator. No checks are made on whether the path is valid or exists. It always outputs symbols, even if a component looks like a number: that makes them harder to [route], but keeps zero-padded numbers intact (think "2020/01/01/0042.wav").
